headline: SIMULATION: War with Iran closes Hormuz; fuel rationing likely in Australia and retaliatory cyber attacks under way.
summary: THIS IS A SIMULATION - NOTHING HAS HAPPENED. In this scenario, strikes on Iran have led Iran to close the Strait of Hormuz and attack Gulf shipping. Three areas are elevated at once (conflict, fuel supply and cyber) and the government has issued advice, which is what Level 4 means. Act on the family plan now, while shops and servos are still normal.
actions: Fill the car and fuel cans today
Buy two weeks of food, water and medicines
